trigger_condition: OperationCanceledException with non-cts token (host shutdown) not caught

trigger_condition: response non-null but first output non-null with null message content

trigger_condition: Parameters property exists but throws on getter invocation

trigger_condition: EmbeddingDimensions is zero or negative

potential_consequence: Record may be double-counted on retry or stay in live queue as duplicate with distinct Attempts

trigger_condition: Payload deserializes to record with null required fields
